name: What is the average cost to paint kitchen cabinets in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost to paint kitchen cabinets in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to paint kitchen cabinets in the Bay Area varies significantly based on several factors, including the number of cabinets, the complexity of the existing finish, the type of paint chosen, and the amount of preparation required. Professional services typically range from $3,000 to $9,000 or more for an average-sized kitchen. A detailed quote requires an in-home consultation to assess the specific scope of work and your desired finishes. We offer transparent pricing after a free estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: The average cost to paint kitchen cabinets in the Bay Area ranges from $3,000 to $9,000+. Price depends on cabinet count, existing finish, paint type, and prep work.
